english.title: Intentionally or recklessly interfere with pipe, structure, installation or apparatus of water supply licensee
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the water supply licensee, intentionally or recklessly interfered with

(A)_[a pipe vested in]_
(B)_[a structure, namely **(..SPECIFY STRUCTURE..), belonging to]_
(C)_[an installation, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTALLATION..), belonging to]_
(D)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..), belonging to]_

(E)_[that licensee,]_
(F)_[a water supply licensee, namely **(..SPECIFY LICENSEE..),]_

and was used in connection with the carrying on by the licensee of the activities authorised by the licensee's licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 174(1A)(a) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
